content.text:
No. Ball1 passes through ring1 and strikes lever1. The attached striker pushes cart1, but cart1 then collides with ring1 at 0.70 s, after moving approximately 0.23 m. It stops about 0.19 m short of domino1. Lever1 reaches its −45° stop, then returns to horizontal; ball1 eventually rests on the floor.

The correction puts the cart and domino in a separate lateral lane, reached by an extended striker, so the ring cannot block the cart. This revision is untested and retains the DSL’s previously disclosed slide and restitution approximations.
